title: Collaborative logo assembly

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Make participation visible in an identity reveal because the way a symbol appears can explain what a product enables.
strategic_value: Several cursors assembling the Figma mark can make shared authorship recognizable before any explanatory copy appears.
demonstration: A cursor selects the Figma wordmark; several colored cursors then move separated logo components into the familiar vertical mark.
practical_value: Use an identity reveal to demonstrate the product’s collaborative behavior.

content_islands.name: Wordmark selection
content_islands.spec: Begin with black lettering on white and a blue selection box controlled by a cursor.

content_islands.name: Shared construction
content_islands.spec: Move separate colored symbol parts with several cursors before resolving the complete mark.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip uses colored pointers and selection handles to assemble the Figma symbol.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study explains that the campaign invites people beyond designers to collaborate on Figma.
